name: sloper-apple-glass
description: Static contract for Sloper's quiet Apple-inspired Liquid Glass operator console.

forbiddenCssPatterns.reason: Apple's canvas uses solid tonal chapters rather than ambient radial gradients.
Ambient gradient tokens make ordinary dashboard surfaces look decorative.

discouragedCssPatterns.reason: Linear gradients should be limited to loading/skeleton motion, not content surfaces.

requiredMarkers.reason: Motion must have a reduced-motion path.
Glass must have a reduced-transparency fallback.
The shell should reserve actual glass treatment for chrome.
The mobile navigation drawer must be removed from the tab order when closed.
Icon and compact controls need accessible names.
The shell brand mark must be the original raven logo.

forbiddenComponentPatterns.reason: Use semantic surface tokens instead of hard-coded component backgrounds.
Use semantic text tokens instead of hard-coded component text colors.
The sidebar should show the raven beside only the lowercase sloper wordmark.
